title: Citymapper Route Daily Event Volume
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090/readsb/tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=citymapper:route
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(mode) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Citymapper route events land each day and how many distinct mode values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Citymapper route records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct mode values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep how much Citymapper route activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
